package approvals

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/auditapp/internal/domain"
	auditmodels "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/approvals"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
)

// Approve approves one request and records the audit event in the same
// transaction: both commit or neither does, for the verified tenant only.
func Approve(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p ApprovePorts,
	in models.ApproveRequest,
) error {
	if in.ID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: id", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"request": in.ID})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return p.TxDB.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		if err := p.Requests.ApproveTx(ctx, tx, in); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return p.AuditEvents.AppendTx(ctx, tx, auditmodels.NewEvent{
			Type:    "approval.approved",
			Payload: payload,
		})
	})
}
